_note: Playstyle for the Storm energy deck: the whole game is a race to tier 3, whose power is a free Art that draws two cards every Combat. The Master rules out the Favor win and shields Acclaim, so Acclaim is only fuel for the climb: two-Acclaim Arts, Transformation and Mutual Escalation all go toward it, and the opponent must not be handed their own top tier on the way. Arts cost Vigor, so Vigor is worth keeping. The Automaton search package and the searching blocks are the card engine: blocks that replace themselves are cheap to spend. The win itself is wounds from Arts.
name: storm_volley
